text:
Anna: deploying model-routing v2 to canary pool now (22:00 UTC). will stream logs here. plan: deploy -> smoke checks -> wait 10m -> promote. rollback window 30m after promote. I'll shout when done.
Sam: on metrics. watching p50/p95/errors dashboard.
Raj: will run quick curl traffic test and edge-case prompts. ping me if i should kick off canary-traffic.
Tess: i'll be on console checks + alerts. thresholds: error_rate >0.5% or 5xx spike.
Mike: rollback command ready: 
```bash
rctl release rollback --service model-router --to previous --region us-west-2
```
deploy-bot: release model-routing v2 started by Anna at 22:01 UTC — canary group: 10% traffic.
Anna: canary deploy completed. logs ok so far. starting smoke checklist:
- curl health endpoint
- sample generation (chat + long-context)
- latency check p95
Raj: running health curl:
```bash
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://api.redwood.example/health
# returns 200
```
Sam: metrics: p50 78ms, p95 210ms, errors 0.12% — watch p95 closely.
Tess: dashboards loaded, no new alerts. setting watch for error_rate >0.4%.
Anna: running sample prompt: "Summarize product plan" -> output looks good.
~4m later~
Sam: p95 for model-A spiked to 340ms for a 2min window, traffic still at 10%. error rate steady.
Raj: weird, KV cache miss rate jumped. trying cache warmup script:
```python
# warmup snippet
for prompt in seed_prompts:
    requests.post(API, json={"input": prompt})
```
Mike: prepping scale command:
```bash
rctl scale service model-router --replicas +2 --region us-west-2
```
Anna: scaling up now.
~3m later~
Sam: p95 back to ~95ms, errors unchanged. looks stable.
Anna: promoting canary to 50% then 100% in 10m if no regressions. holding rollout for 10m.
Tess: leaving an alert if anything crosses thresholds. I'll DM oncall if anything pops.
Raj: LGTM. will follow-up with perf logs.
Mike: rollback still ready if needed.
Anna: thanks all — posting summary for release notes and follow-up items:
- root cause: cold KV cache on canary, remedied by warmup + scaling
- follow-ups: add pre-warm step to rollout playbook, monitor kv-hit metrics next week
:thumbsup:
